cues.zh: 最近我有几个朋友去了塔斯马尼亚的戈登大坝，
cues.en: Recently some friends of mine went to the Gordon Dam in Tasmania,

cues.zh: 坝高126.5米（也就是415英尺）。
cues.en: which is 126.5 meters (or 415 feet) high.

cues.zh: 然后他们从坝顶边缘扔下一个篮球。
cues.en: Then they dropped a basketball over the edge.

cues.zh: 你可以看到篮球被微风推得有点偏，
cues.en: You can see that the basketball gets pushed around a bit by the breeze,

cues.zh: 但它基本上就落在被扔下位置的正下方。
cues.en: but it lands basically right below where it was dropped.

cues.zh: 现在看看他们再扔一个篮球会发生什么，
cues.en: Now watch what happens when they drop another basketball,

cues.zh: 不过这次带一点回旋……
cues.en: but this time with a bit of backspin...

cues.zh: “哇，看它飞出去了！”
cues.en: "Woah, look at that go!"

cues.zh: “太不可思议了。”
cues.en: "That's incredible."

cues.zh: “这是刚扔球的Bret。”
cues.en: "This is Bret who just threw it."

cues.zh: 我真的只是把它放下，带了一点旋转，
cues.en: I litterally just dropped it, with a bit of spin,

cues.zh: 我甚至都没扔，它就直接飞出去了，我们完全没想到会这样。
cues.en: like I didn't even throw it, and it just took off, like we had no idea that was gonna do that.

cues.zh: 这就是我要讲的地方：
cues.en: And this is where I come in:

cues.zh: 篮球受到了马格努斯效应的影响，
cues.en: the basketball was subject to the Magnus effect,

cues.zh: 这个效应会影响所有在空中飞行的旋转球体或圆柱体。
cues.en: which affects all rotating balls or cylinders as they fly through the air.

cues.zh: 它是这样运作的：
cues.en: And it works like this:

cues.zh: 随着篮球速度加快，
cues.en: as the basketball picks up speed,

cues.zh: 球正面的空气与球的旋转方向相同，
cues.en: air on the front side of the ball is going in the same direction as its spin,

cues.zh: 因此它被球带着一起走，并被偏转回去。
cues.en: and therefore it gets dragged along with the ball and deflected back.

cues.zh: 另一侧的空气与球的旋转方向相反，
cues.en: Air on the other side is moving opposite to the ball spin,

cues.zh: 所以气流会从球面分离，而不是被偏转。
cues.en: so the flow separates from the ball instead of getting deflected.

cues.zh: 最终的结果是球把空气推向一个方向，
cues.en: The net result is the ball pushes air one way,

cues.zh: 于是空气对球施加一个大小相等、方向相反的力。
cues.en: so the air applies an equal force on the ball the other way.

cues.zh: 这就是所谓的马格努斯效应，
cues.en: And this is known as the Magnus effect,

cues.zh: 以1852年描述该现象的Heinrich Gustav Magnus命名。
cues.en: named after Heinrich Gustav Magnus who described it in 1852.

cues.zh: 当然，Isaac Newton比他早了近两百年，
cues.en: Of course, Isaac Newton beat him to it by nearly two hundred years,

cues.zh: 在剑桥学院描述了网球的飞行轨迹。
cues.en: describing the flight of tennis balls at Cambridge College.

cues.zh: 不过，你知道，以他命名东西已经够多了……
cues.en: But, you know, he's got enough stuff named after him....

cues.zh: 这种效应在网球、足球和高尔夫等运动中非常重要，
cues.en: This effect is very important in sports like tennis, soccer and golf,

cues.zh: 但它能否用于非运动领域呢？
cues.en: but could it have non-sport applications?

cues.zh: 也许可以。
cues.en: Perhaps.

cues.zh: 这是一艘帆船。我知道它看起来不像帆船，
cues.en: This is a sailboat. I know it doesn't look like a sailboat,

cues.zh: 但那些不是烟囱。
cues.en: but those aren't chimneys.

cues.zh: 它们是旋转的圆柱体，叫做“Flettner转子”，
cues.en: They are spinning cylinders called "Flettner rotors",

cues.zh: 它们取代了帆的作用。
cues.en: and they take the place of the sails.

cues.zh: 它们利用马格努斯效应偏转侧风，推动船只前进。
cues.en: They deflect crosswinds, using the Magnus effect, to propel the ship forwards.

cues.zh: 而这是一架用旋转圆柱体代替机翼的飞机。
cues.en: And this is a plane with spinning cylinders instead of wings.

cues.zh: 利用马格努斯效应，这些圆柱体实际上能产生比传统机翼更大的升力。
cues.en: Using the Magnus effect, the cylinders actually generate more lift than traditional wings.

cues.zh: 然而它们也会产生大得多的阻力，使其不切实际。
cues.en: However they also generate way more drag, making them impractical.

cues.zh: 这架飞机只飞了一次，然后就坠毁了。
cues.en: This place only flew once, and then it crashed.

cues.zh: 但马格努斯效应正在卷土重来。
cues.en: But the Magnus effect is making a comeback.

cues.zh: 这是一架实验性旋翼机，它的全部升力都来自旋转圆柱体。
cues.en: Here is an experimental rotor wing aircraft which generates all its lift from spinning cylinders.

cues.zh: 这就是E-Ship 1，它用了四个旋转圆筒（也就是四个Flettner转子）
cues.en: And this is the E-Ship 1 which uses four spinning cylinders (that's four Flettner rotors)

cues.zh: 来提高效率，减少柴油消耗。
cues.en: to increase its efficiency and reduce the amount of diesel it burns.

cues.zh: 所以未来，马格努斯效应可能不只帮篮球飞起来。
cues.en: So, in the future, the Magnus effect may help more than just basketballs fly.

cues.zh: “哇，看那个飞出去了！”
cues.en: "Woah, look at that go!"

cues.zh: 其实我那些来自“How Ridiculous”的朋友们出现在大坝上
cues.en: Now the real reason my friends from "How Ridiculous" were at the dam

cues.zh: 是为了创造最高投篮的世界纪录。
cues.en: was to set the world record for the highest basket ever scored.

cues.zh: 所以去看看他们的频道和视频吧，
cues.en: So go check out their channel and the video,

cues.zh: 订阅他们，看更多超炫的花式投篮。
cues.en: and subscribe to them for more epic trickshots.
